text: I have four Oasis tickets, £150 each | No rush, pay when you're ready | Please transfer the money to my partner's account | There's an extra £200 to cover the name changes
notes: Confirmed scam. Rebuilt from the victim's account: first contact via a hacked Facebook account of a real friend, then moved to WhatsApp. No urgency at all, paid to a 'partner's' account, plus a £200 'name change' fee (£800 in total). Victim is in Jersey, but the tickets were for the Oasis 2025 UK reunion tour.
